title: NAD Metabolism Drives CTCF-Cohesin Chromatin Regulation in EBV-Transformed B-Cells.
authors: Maestri, Davide; Sklutuis, Rachel; Caruso, Lisa Beatrice; Preston-Alp, Sarah; Gatto, Martina; Soldan, Samantha S; Park, Pyounghwa; Melick, Lauren; Corveleyn, Laura; Sidoli, Simone; Kossenkov, Andrew; Goldman, Aaron R; Zhang, Wujuan; Tang, Hsin-Yao; Napoletani, Giorgia; Liao, Yifei; Lieberman, Paul M; Gewurz, Benjamin E; Tempera, Italo
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NAD代谢调控CTCF-cohesin染色质结构，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
abstract: Chromatin architecture regulates gene expression, and it is maintained by architectural proteins such as CTCF and the cohesin complex. In Epstein-Barr virus infected cells, viral chromatin organization is stabilized through the interaction between PARP1 and CTCF, ensuring maintenance of latent gene expression. EBV(+) B cells exhibit elevated PARP1 activity, which imposes a substantial metabolic burden due to NAD(+) consumption by PARP1 itself. We demonstrate that efficient EBV infection and B-cell transformation rely on the NAD salvage pathway to sustain PARP1 activity and CTCF-cohesin chromatin folding. Pharmacologic inhibition of the rate-limiting enzyme NAMPT with FK866 phenocopies the chromatin architectural disruption induced by PARP1 and changes in NAD levels affects CTCF/cohesin chromatin architectural remodeling and loop extrusion. Moreover, NAMPT inhibition reduces tumor burden in EBV(+) xenograft models. These findings identify a critical metabolic dependency linking NAD(+) homeostasis to CTCF/cohesin mediated chromatin architecture and reveal a therapeutic vulnerability in EBV-associated malignancies.
abstract_zh: 染色质结构调控基因表达，其维持依赖于CTCF和cohesin复合物等结构蛋白。在Epstein-Barr病毒感染的细胞中，病毒染色质组织通过PARP1与CTCF之间的相互作用得以稳定，确保潜伏基因表达的维持。EBV(+) B细胞表现出升高的PARP1活性，这因PARP1自身消耗NAD(+)而施加了显著的代谢负担。我们证明，高效的EBV感染和B细胞转化依赖于NAD补救途径，以维持PARP1活性和CTCF-cohesin染色质折叠。对限速酶NAMPT的药理学抑制，使用FK866，模拟了由PARP1诱导的染色质结构破坏，且NAD水平的变化影响CTCF/cohesin染色质结构重塑和环挤出。此外，NAMPT抑制在EBV(+)异种移植模型中减少了肿瘤负担。这些发现识别出一种关键的代谢依赖性，将NAD(+)稳态与CTCF/cohesin介导的染色质结构联系起来，并揭示了EBV相关恶性肿瘤中的治疗脆弱性。
